cat > /tmp/review-body.md <<'EOF'
## Verify pass — APPROVE

Verified the exact delivered revision `03e6e75` against acceptance criteria AC1–AC5. Gates were re-run independently in this worktree.

### Acceptance criteria (each tied to evidence)

- **AC1 — stack rationale recorded.** `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` records Astro 5 (static output), Node 20+, pnpm 11, MDX, `@astrojs/sitemap`, `@astrojs/rss`, strict TS, sourced to §2 of the binding design spec with a "zero client JavaScript by default" rationale. Guarded by the `architecture records the binding Astro stack and rationale` test.
- **AC2 — real manifest/layout/workflow replace pending guidance.** Real `package.json` (astro deps, pnpm@11, node>=20.3), `src/` layout (`pages/`, `layouts/Base.astro`, `components/`, `styles/`), pnpm workflow. Pending guidance replaced in README, AGENTS.md, ARCHITECTURE, REQUIREMENTS, RUNBOOK, TESTING, `config.yaml`. Guarded by the `repository provides the Astro manifest, source layout, and pnpm workflow` test.
- **AC3 — non-vacuous test_command.** `test_command: pnpm test` → `astro build && node --test tests/*.test.mjs`. The named `home page presents the agent-native value proposition and ordered trust ladder` test reads generated `dist/index.html` and asserts the value proposition plus the exact read-only → reversible+guardrails → autonomous ordering. Proven non-vacuous: an in-memory mutation of the built HTML makes the assertion throw `ERR_ASSERTION`. Suite: 7 passed, 0 failed (exit 0).
- **AC4 — meaningful lint + setup.** `lint_command: pnpm lint` → `astro check` (strict TS/template static analysis): 13 files, 0 errors (exit 0). `setup_command: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` succeeds against the committed lockfile (exit 0).
- **AC5 — observable result + docs.** Static home page renders at `/` to `dist/index.html` (hero, trust ladder, writing/projects previews, about). RUNBOOK and README document install/dev/build and what to observe at `/`. Design tokens and copy verified as a faithful match to the binding prototype.

### Security & scope
- Static site: no server, auth, user input, or injection surface; `description` meta sources from hardcoded constants. No secrets tracked (`.env*` gitignored); build artifacts all gitignored and untracked.
- Scope stays within the ticket: one page + supporting components + behavior/contract tests. mdx/sitemap/rss installed as spec-mandated stack establishment; `/blog`, `/projects`, `/about`, RSS, and deploy explicitly deferred. Environment note honored — no duplicate `allowBuilds` key; `.pnpm-store/` ignored, not committed.

Findings: none. Remaining risk is ordinary maintenance risk.
EOF
echo "body written: $(wc -l < /tmp/review-body.md) lines"
